howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Create tiers with a name, minimum spending per currency, and/or a minimum paid order count.
howItWorks.step2: Click "Apply to All Users" to evaluate and assign tiers to every existing user.
howItWorks.step3: Every time a user completes a payment, their tier is automatically re-evaluated.
howItWorks.step4: Users are assigned the first (highest) tier they qualify for. A user qualifies if they meet EITHER the spending OR the order count threshold.
